title: Complete Relational Description of Spin in a Quantum Background
summary: The standard description of the state of a spin in quantum mechanics presupposes externally fixed directions -- a classical background. Can a spin be fully described instead in relation to other quantum mechanical systems? Poulin suggested twenty years ago group averaging over rotations the joint state of a fundamental spin and a reference spin with large angular momentum which, however, yields a classical bit in a probabilistic mixture.
